ko.title: 아이다호 낙농가, 아직 닥치지 않은 단속을 기다리며 불안해하는 이민자 단속 우려

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: 현 정부의 이민 단속 추진 과정에서 농업 분야는 대체로 주목받지 않았습니다.

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: 아이다호의 낙농업자들에게 이는 안도감과 함께 불안감을 가져왔습니다.

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: 업계의 일부 추정에 따르면 이들 중 다수는 합법적 신분이 없는 근로자가 대부분인 인력에 의존하고 있습니다.

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: 그들은 이 고요함이 얼마나 지속될지 궁금해합니다.

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## 낙농업이 다른 농업 일자리와 다른 이유

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: 아이다호는 미국에서 가장 큰 우유 생산 주 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: 이곳의 낙농가는 1년 365일 가동됩니다.

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: 소들은 휴일이나 비수기 없이 모든 계절에 매일 두 세 번씩 젖을 짠니다.

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: 이러한 일정은 낙농업을 미국의 다른 많은 농업 분야와 구별 짓습니다.

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: 연방 H-2A 농업 게스트 워커 프로그램의 대부분은 파종 및 수확과 같은 계절 노동을 위해 구축되었으므로, 낙농업 일자리는 이 모델에 맞지 않습니다.

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: 상시(연중) 일자리는 일반적으로 이 프로그램의 핵심 설계 범위 밖에 있습니다.

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: 낙농업자들은 오래전부터 이 때문에 필요한 인력을 고용할 합법적인 통로가 거의 없다고 지적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: 생산자 단체와 농업 노동을 연구하는 연구자들에 따르면 그 결과 이민자 비중이 큰 인력 구조가 형성되었습니다.

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: 일부 개별 농장주들은 자신들의 착유 팀 대부분이 불법체류자라고 설명합니다.

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: 정확한 수치를 파악한 곳이 없기 때문에 이 수치들은 추정치입니다.

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: 또한 농장마다 차이가 큽니다.

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## 아직 축사까지 미치지 않은 단속

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: 최근의 단속은 주로 도시 지역, 타 산업의 사업장, 범죄 기록이 있는 사람들 등 다른 환경에 집중되었습니다.

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: 농장에서는 아직 많은 농장주들이 우려했던 만큼의 대규모 단속 작업이 발생하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: 농업 분야 지도자들은 워싱턴으로부터 상충되는 신호를 들었다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: 농업 근로자에 대한 정책 발표는 시간이 지나면서 변해 왔으며, 때로는 농장에 대한 유연성을 시사하다가도 때로는 광범위한 단속을 강조하기도 했습니다.

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: 이러한 일관성 부족은 계획 수립을 어렵게 만듭니다.

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: 농장주는 올지 안 올지 모르는 급습에 대비하기가 거의 불가능합니다.

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: 명문상의 규정 중 농장이 면제 상태로 유지된다고 보장하는 것은 없습니다.

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: 오늘 안도감을 느끼는 낙농업자들도 새로운 지침, 새로운 예산 투입 또는 단 한 건의 주목받는 사건으로 인해 상황이 급변할 수 있음을 알고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## 농가에 걸려 있는 위험요인

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: 농장주들과 업계 대변인들은 몇 가지 우려 사항을 설명합니다.

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **대체하기 어려운 노동력.** 착유는 숙련되고 육체적으로 고된 작업입니다. 농장주들은 임금이 올라도 이 일자리를 찾는 현지 지원자가 거의 없으며, 신규 채용자를 교육하는 데 시간이 걸린다고 말합니다.

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **동물 복지 및 우유 품질.** 착유를 놓친 소는 건강 문제가 발생할 수 있습니다. 갑작스러운 인력 부족은 며칠 내로 동물과 제품 품질에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **적은 마진.** 낙농업은 마진이 적고 자본 집약적인 산업입니다. 짧은 시간이라도 인력의 일부를 잃으면 심각한 재정적 타격을 입을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **파급 효과.** 낙농가는 가공업체, 사료 판매상, 운송 회사, 치즈 및 요거트 공장에 원유를 공급합니다. 농장의 차질은 농촌 경제 전체로 확산될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## 농장주들이 준비하는 사항

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: 명확한 합법적 경로가 없는 상황에서 많은 농가들은 조용히 비상 계획을 세우고 있습니다.

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: 일반적인 조치로는 고용 서류 검토, 이민 전문 변호사 자문, 단속 발생 시 대처 방법에 대해 근로자들과 이야기하는 것 등이 있습니다.

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: 일부는 로봇 착유 시스템과 같은 자동화를 고려하고 있습니다.

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: 이러한 기계는 노동력 수요를 줄일 수 있지만 비용이 매우 많이 들기 때문에 규모가 작은 농장에서는 감당하기 어려운 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: 고용주는 고용 관행이 연방법의 적용을 받는다는 점도 알고 있어야 합니다.

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: 취업 자격 확인 요건이 적용되며, 위반 시 벌금이 상당할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: 법률 전문가들은 일반적으로 농장 고용주에게 소문이나 비공식적인 안내에 의존하는 대신 자신들의 상황에 맞춘 전문적인 자문을 받을 것을 권장합니다.

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## 정책 논쟁

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: 낙농업 노동 문제는 수년간 논쟁을 불러일으켜 왔습니다.

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: 엄격한 단속을 지지하는 사람들은 고용주가 법을 준수해야 하며 미승인 노동력에 대한 의존이 임금을 낮추고 합법적인 이민 경로를 훼손한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: 농업 단체들과 많은 경제학자들은 현재의 시스템이 연중 계속되는 농업 일자리에 대해 실행 가능한 옵션을 제공하지 못한다고 반박하며, 낙농업 및 기타 비계절 농업 노동을 위해 설계된 비자 범주와 같은 개혁을 촉구합니다.

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: 시스템을 변경하려는 제안은 의회에서 반복적으로 제기되었으나 입법화되지 못했습니다.

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: 무언가 바뀌기 전까지 이 산업은 고용주와 근로자 모두를 위험에 노출시키는 회색 지대에 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 사항

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 진전 사항을 통해 고요함이 계속될지 여부를 가늠할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. 농업 현장 단속에 관한 새로운 연방 지침.

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. 연중 농업 비자를 신설하기 위한 입법적 노력.

segments.src: 3. Changes to the H-2A program, including how it treats dairy.
segments.tr: 3. 낙농업 취급 방식을 포함한 H-2A 프로그램의 변경 사항.

segments.src: 4. Reports of enforcement activity in farm communities in Idaho or nearby states.
segments.tr: 4. 아이다호 또는 인근 주의 농업 지역 내 단속 활동 보고.

segments.src: For now, Idaho's dairy country is in a waiting period.
segments.tr: 현재 아이다호의 낙농 지대는 대기 상태에 있습니다.

segments.src: The milking continues every day, but the people doing it, and the owners who depend on them, are uncertain about what comes next.
segments.tr: 착유는 매일 계속되지만, 그 일을 하는 사람들과 그들에게 의존하는 농장주들은 다음에 무슨 일이 일어날지 불안해하고 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is intended for general information and does not constitute legal advice.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 법률적 자문을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Figures cited are industry estimates and may vary by source and region.*
segments.tr: 인용된 수치는 업계 추정치이며 출처 및 지역에 따라 다를 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 爱达荷州的奶牛场正在等待尚未到来的移民镇压，并担心它即将发生

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: 在当前政府推进的移民执法行动中，农业在很大程度上并没有成为焦点。

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: 对于爱达荷州的奶牛场主来说，这带来了一丝宽慰，但同时也夹杂着不安。

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: 据一些行业估计，他们中的许多人依赖的劳动力大部分是没有合法身份的工人。

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: 他们想知道这种平静还能持续多久。

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## 为什么奶牛场与其他农场工作不同

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: 爱达荷州是美国最大的牛奶生产州之一。

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: 这里的奶牛场一年 365 天每天都在运转。

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: 不论季节，奶牛每天要挤奶两到三次，在假期或不繁忙的时期也没有休息。

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: 这种时间安排使乳制品业与美国的大部分农业区别开来。

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: 联邦 H-2A 农业客座工人计划的大部分内容都是为种植和收获等季节性工作设计的，而奶牛场的岗位并不符合这种模式。

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: 全年性岗位通常超出了该计划的核心设计范围。

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: 长期以来，奶牛场主一直表示，这让他们几乎没有合法渠道来引进所需的工人。

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: 根据研究农业劳动力的生产商团体和研究人员的说法，结果是劳动力中移民占很大比例。

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: 一些具体的经营者将他们的挤奶团队描述为绝大多数是无公文身份的。

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: 这些数字是估计值，因为没有人有精确的统计。

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: 不同农场之间的情况差异也很大。

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## 尚未蔓延至牛棚的镇压

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: 当前时期的执法主要集中在其他场景，包括城市社区、其他行业的工场以及有犯罪记录的人员。

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: 到目前为止，农场经历的大规模执法行动比许多农场主所担心的要少。

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: 农业领域的领导人表示，他们收到了来自华盛顿的矛盾信号。

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: 关于农业工人的政策声明随着时间的推移发生了变化，有时暗示对农场保持灵活性，有时又强调广泛执法。

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: 这种不一致性使规划变得困难。

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: 农场主很难为一场可能发生也可能不发生的突袭做准备。

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: 没有任何明确法规能够保证农场可以一直获得豁免。

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: 今天感到安全的奶牛场经营者清楚，随着一项新指令、一项新的资金投入或单一起高调案件的出现，局势可能会迅速改变。

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## 农场面临的风险

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: 经营者和行业倡导者提出了几项担忧：

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **难以替代的劳动力。** 挤奶是一项需要技能且消耗体力的工作。农场主表示，即使工资上涨，也很少有当地求职者应聘这些岗位，而且培训新员工需要时间。

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **动物福利和牛奶质量。** 错过挤奶的奶牛可能会出现健康问题。工人的突然短缺可能会在几天内影响到动物和产品质量。

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **微薄的利润率。** 乳制品业是一个低利润、资本密集型的行业。哪怕只是在短时间内失去一部分员工，也可能意味着严重的经济损失。

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **连锁反应。** 奶牛场为加工厂、饲料商、运输公司以及奶酪和酸奶厂提供原料。农场的中断可能会蔓延至整个乡村经济。

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## 农场主正采取什么措施来准备

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: 在没有明确合法途径的情况下，许多农场正低调地制定应急计划。

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: 常见的步骤包括审查雇佣文件、咨询移民律师，以及与工人交流如果发生执法行动该怎么办。

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: 一些农场正在考虑自动化，例如自动挤奶机器人系统。

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: 这些机器可以减少劳动力需求，但成本高昂，规模较小的农场往往负担不起。

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: 雇主还应该知道，招聘行为受联邦法律管辖。

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: 核实工作资格的要求同样适用，违法行为的罚款可能相当严重。

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: 法律专家通常建议农场雇主根据自身情况寻求专业建议，而不是依赖传言或非正式指导。

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## 政策辩论

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: 奶牛场劳动力问题多年来一直引发争论。

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: 支持更严格执法的人士主张，雇主应当守法，依赖未经授权的劳动力会压低工资并破坏合法移民渠道。

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: 农业团体和许多经济学家反驳称，现行体系没有为全年性农业岗位提供可行的选择，他们呼吁进行改革，例如设立专门针对乳制品和其他非季节性农场工作的签证类别。

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: 改变该体系的提案已多次在国会提出，但尚未成为法律。

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: 在发生改变之前，该行业仍处于灰色地带，使雇主和工人都暴露于风险之中。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 值得关注的动态

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: 以下几项进展可能会表明平静是否会持续：

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. 关于农业场所执法的任何新联邦指导意见。

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. 旨在创建全年性农业签证的立法努力。

segments.src: 3. Changes to the H-2A program, including how it treats dairy.
segments.tr: 3. 对 H-2A 计划的修改，包括其对待乳制品业的方式。

segments.src: 4. Reports of enforcement activity in farm communities in Idaho or nearby states.
segments.tr: 4. 有关爱达荷州或邻近州农场社区执法活动的报道。

segments.src: For now, Idaho's dairy country is in a waiting period.
segments.tr: 目前，爱达荷州的奶牛场地区正处于等待期。

segments.src: The milking continues every day, but the people doing it, and the owners who depend on them, are uncertain about what comes next.
segments.tr: 挤奶工作每天都在继续，但从事这项工作的人，以及依赖他们的农场主，都对接下来的发展感到不确定。

hi.title: अडाहो के डेयरी फार्म उस आव्रजन कार्रवाई का इंतजार कर रहे हैं जो अभी तक नहीं आई है, और चिंता है कि यह आ रही है

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: मौजूदा प्रशासन के आव्रजन प्रवर्तन अभियान के दौरान कृषि काफी हद तक सुर्खियों से दूर रही है।

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: अडाहो में डेयरी मालिकों के लिए, इससे राहत के साथ-साथ बेचैनी भी आई है।

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: उनमें से कई एक ऐसे कार्यबल पर भरोसा करते हैं, जो कुछ उद्योग अनुमानों के अनुसार, ज्यादातर ऐसे श्रमिकों से बना है जिनके पास कानूनी स्थिति नहीं है।

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: वे सोचते हैं कि यह शांति कितने समय तक रहेगी।

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## डेयरी अन्य खेत के काम से क्यों अलग है

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: अडाहो देश के सबसे बड़े दूध उत्पादक राज्यों में से एक है।

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: इसकी डेयरी साल के हर दिन चलती हैं।

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: गायों को हर मौसम में, छुट्टियों या कम काम के समय के बिना किसी विराम के, प्रतिदिन दो या तीन बार दूध निकाला जाता है।

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: वह शेड्यूल डेयरी को अमेरिकी कृषि के एक बड़े हिस्से से अलग करता है।

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: संघीय H-2A कृषि अतिथि-श्रमिक कार्यक्रम का अधिकांश हिस्सा रोपण और कटाई जैसे मौसमी काम के लिए बनाया गया है, और डेयरी नौकरियां उस मॉडल में फिट नहीं बैठती हैं।

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: साल भर के पद आम तौर पर कार्यक्रम के मूल डिजाइन से बाहर आते हैं।

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: डेयरी मालिकों ने लंबे समय से कहा है कि इससे उन्हें अपनी जरूरत के श्रमिकों को लाने के लिए बहुत कम कानूनी रास्ते मिलते हैं।

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: उत्पादक समूहों और खेत के श्रम का अध्ययन करने वाले शोधकर्ताओं के अनुसार, इसका परिणाम आप प्रवासियों के एक बड़े हिस्से के साथ एक कार्यबल है।

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: कुछ व्यक्तिगत ऑपरेटर अपने दूध दुहने वाले दलों को अत्यधिक रूप से बिना दस्तावेजों के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: ये आंकड़े अनुमान हैं, क्योंकि किसी के पास सटीक गिनती नहीं है।

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: वे एक खेत से दूसरे खेत में भी काफी भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## एक कार्रवाई जो अभी तक खलिहान तक नहीं पहुंची है

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: वर्तमान अवधि में प्रवर्तन ज्यादातर अन्य सेटिंग्स पर केंद्रित रहा है, जिसमें शहरी पड़ोस, अन्य उद्योगों में कार्यस्थल और आपराधिक रिकॉर्ड वाले लोग शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: खेतों में अब तक कई मालिकों की आशंका से कम बड़े पैमाने पर संचालन देखा गया है।

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: कृषि-क्षेत्र के नेताओं का कहना है कि उन्हें वाशिंगटन से मिश्रित संकेत मिले हैं।

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: कृषि श्रमिकों पर नीतिगत बयान समय के साथ बदल गए हैं, कभी-कभी खेतों के लिए लचीलेपन का सुझाव देते हैं और अन्य समय में व्यापक प्रवर्तन पर जोर देते हैं।

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: वह असंगति योजना को कठिन बनाती है।

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: एक मालिक शायद ही किसी छापे की तैयारी कर सकता है जो आ भी सकता है और नहीं भी।

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: पुस्तकों पर ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं है जो गारंटी देता है कि खेत छूट प्राप्त रहेंगे।

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: आज सुरक्षित महसूस करने वाले डेयरी ऑपरेटर जानते हैं कि एक नए निर्देश, एक नए वित्त पोषण के जोर, या एक उच्च-प्रोफ़ाइल मामले के साथ स्थिति जल्दी बदल सकती है।

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## खेतों के लिए दांव पर क्या है

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: मालिक और उद्योग के वकील कई चिंताओं का वर्णन करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **श्रम जिसे बदलना कठिन है।** दूध दुहना कुशल, शारीरिक रूप से मांग वाला काम है। मालिकों का कहना है कि कुछ स्थानीय आवेदक इन नौकरियों की तलाश करते हैं, तब भी जब मजदूरी बढ़ जाती है, और नए भाड़े को प्रशिक्षित करने में समय लगता है।

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: ## पशु कल्याण और दूध की गुणवत्ता।** गाय जो दूध दुहना भूल जाती हैं, उनमें स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं विकसित हो सकती हैं। श्रमिकों की अचानक कमी दिनों के भीतर जानवरों और उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता को प्रभावित कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **पतला मार्जिन।** डेयरी कम मार्जिन वाला, पूंजी-गहन व्यवसाय है। थोड़े समय के लिए भी चालक दल के हिस्से को खोने का मतलब गंभीर वित्तीय नुकसान हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **लहर प्रभाव।** डेयरी प्रोसेसर, फीड डीलरों, ट्रकिंग फर्मों और पनीर और दही संयंत्रों की आपूर्ति करती हैं। खेतों में व्यवधान ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के माध्यम से फैल सकता है।

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## मालिक तैयारी के लिए क्या कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: एक स्पष्ट कानूनी रास्ते के बिना, कई खेत चुपचाप आकस्मिक योजनाएं बना रहे हैं।

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: सामान्य चरणों में रोजगार कागजी कार्रवाई की समीक्षा करना, आव्रजन वकीलों से परामर्श करना और प्रवर्तन होने पर क्या करना है, इसके बारे में श्रमिकों से बात करना शामिल है।

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: कुछ स्वचालन को देख रहे हैं, जैसे कि रोबोटिक दूध दुहने की प्रणाली।

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: ये मशीनें श्रम की जरूरतों को कम कर सकती हैं लेकिन बहुत अधिक लागत आती हैं, और छोटे खेत अक्सर उन्हें बर्दाश्त नहीं कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: नियोक्ता को यह भी पता होना चाहिए कि काम पर रखने की प्रथाएं संघीय कानून द्वारा शासित होती हैं।

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: काम की पात्रता सत्यापित करने की आवश्यकताएं लागू होती हैं, और उल्लंघनों के लिए दंड महत्वपूर्ण हो सकता है।

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: कानूनी विशेषज्ञ आम तौर पर खेत नियोक्ताओं को अफवाहों या अनौपचारिक मार्गदर्शन पर भरोसा करने के बजाय उनकी स्थिति के अनुरूप पेशेवर सलाह लेने की सलाह देते हैं।

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## नीतिगत बहस

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: डेयरी श्रम समस्या ने वर्षों से बहस को हवा दी है।

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: कड़े प्रवर्तन के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि नियोक्ताओं को कानून का पालन करना चाहिए और अनधिकृत श्रम पर निर्भरता मजदूरी को दबाती है और कानूनी आव्रजन चैनलों को कमजोर करती है।

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: कृषि समूह और कई अर्थशास्त्री मुकाबला करते हैं कि वर्तमान प्रणाली साल भर के कृषि कार्यों के लिए काम के विकल्प प्रदान नहीं करती है, और वे डेयरी और अन्य गैर-मौसमी खेत के काम के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई वीज़ा श्रेणी जैसे सुधारों का आह्वान करते हैं।

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: प्रणाली को बदलने के प्रस्ताव कांग्रेस में बार-बार आए हैं लेकिन कानून नहीं बने हैं।

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: जब तक कुछ बदलता है, उद्योग एक भूरे रंग के क्षेत्र में रहता है जो नियोक्ताओं और श्रमिकों दोनों को उजागर करता है।

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: कई विकास यह दिखा सकते हैं कि क्या शांति जारी है:

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. कृषि स्थलों पर प्रवर्तन पर कोई नया संघीय मार्गदर्शन।

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. साल भर के कृषि वीजा बनाने के लिए विधाई प्रयास।

es.title: Las granjas lecheras de Idaho esperan una represión migratoria que no ha llegado, y temen que esté en camino

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: La agricultura se ha mantenido en gran medida fuera del centro de atención durante la actual campaña de control migratorio del gobierno.

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: Para los propietarios de granjas lecheras en Idaho, esto ha traído un alivio mezclado con inquietud.

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: Muchos de ellos dependen de una fuerza laboral que, según algunas estimaciones del sector, está compuesta en su mayoría por trabajadores sin estatus legal.

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: Se preguntan cuánto durará la calma.

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## Por qué la producción lechera es diferente de otros trabajos agrícolas

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: Idaho es uno de los estados productores de leche más grandes del país.

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: Sus granjas lecheras funcionan todos los días del año.

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: Las vacas se ordeñan dos o tres veces al día, en todas las estaciones, sin interrupciones por días festivos o períodos de baja actividad.

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: Ese calendario diferencia a la producción lechera de gran parte de la agricultura estadounidense.

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: La mayor parte del programa federal de trabajadores agrícolas invitados H-2A está diseñado para trabajos estacionales como la siembra y la cosecha, y los empleos lecheros no se ajustan a ese modelo.

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: Los puestos de trabajo durante todo el año generalmente quedan fuera del diseño principal del programa.

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: Los propietarios de granjas lecheras han dicho durante mucho tiempo que esto les deja pocas vías legales para traer a los trabajadores que necesitan.

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: El resultado, según grupos de productores e investigadores que estudian la mano de obra agrícola, es una fuerza laboral con una gran proporción de inmigrantes.

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: Algunos operadores individuales describen a sus equipos de ordeño como abrumadoramente indocumentados.

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: Estas cifras son estimaciones, ya que nadie tiene un recuento exacto.

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: También varían mucho de una granja a otra.

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## Una represión que aún no ha llegado al establo

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: El control migratorio en el período actual se ha centrado principalmente en otros entornos, incluidos vecindarios urbanos, lugares de trabajo en otras industrias y personas con antecedentes penales.

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: Hasta ahora, las granjas han visto menos operaciones a gran escala de lo que muchos propietarios temían.

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: Los líderes del sector agrícola dicen haber escuchado señales contradictorias de Washington.

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: Las declaraciones de política sobre los trabajadores agrícolas han cambiado con el tiempo, sugiriendo a veces flexibilidad para las granjas y en otras ocasiones enfatizando un control migratorio generalizado.

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: Esa inconsistencia dificulta la planificación.

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: Un propietario difícilmente puede prepararse para una redada que puede o no ocurrir.

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: Nada en las leyes vigentes garantiza que las granjas sigan exentas.

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: Los operadores de granjas lecheras que hoy se sienten seguros saben que la situación podría cambiar rápidamente con una nueva directriz, una nueva campaña de financiación o un solo caso de alto perfil.

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## Lo que está en juego para las granjas

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: Los propietarios y defensores de la industria describen varias preocupaciones:

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **Mano de obra difícil de reemplazar.** El ordeño es un trabajo calificado y físicamente exigente. Los propietarios dicen que pocos solicitantes locales buscan estos empleos, incluso cuando los salarios aumentan, y que capacitar a los nuevos empleados lleva tiempo.

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **Bienestar animal y calidad de la leche.** Las vacas que no se ordeñan pueden desarrollar problemas de salud. Una escasez repentina de trabajadores podría afectar a los animales y a la calidad del producto en cuestión de días.

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **Márgenes estrechos.** La producción lechera es un negocio de bajo margen y uso intensivo de capital. Perder parte de un equipo, incluso por poco tiempo, puede significar un daño financiero grave.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **Efectos colaterales.** Las granjas lecheras abastecen a procesadores, distribuidores de alimentos, empresas de transporte y plantas de queso y yogur. La interrupción en las granjas puede extenderse a través de las economías rurales.

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## Qué están haciendo los propietarios para prepararse

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: Sin una vía legal clara, muchas granjas están elaborando planes de contingencia discretamente.

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: Los pasos comunes incluyen revisar la documentación laboral, consultar con abogados de inmigración y hablar con los trabajadores sobre qué hacer si se produce una acción de control migratorio.

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: Algunos están considerando la automatización, como los sistemas de ordeño robótico.

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: Estas máquinas pueden reducir las necesidades de mano de obra, pero cuestan una gran cantidad de dinero, y las granjas más pequeñas a menudo no pueden permitírselas.

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: Los empleadores también deben saber que las prácticas de contratación están reguladas por la ley federal.

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: Se aplican los requisitos para verificar la elegibilidad laboral, y las sanciones por infracciones pueden ser significativas.

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: Los expertos legales generalmente aconsejan a los empleadores agrícolas obtener asesoramiento profesional adaptado a su situación en lugar de confiar en rumores o pautas informales.

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## El debate político

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: El problema de la mano de obra lechera ha generado debate durante años.

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: Quienes apoyan un control migratorio más estricto argumentan que los empleadores deben cumplir la ley y que la dependencia de mano de obra no autorizada reduce los salarios y debilita las vías de inmigración legal.

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: Los grupos agrícolas y muchos economistas replican que el sistema actual no ofrece opciones viables para empleos agrícolas durante todo el año, y piden reformas como una categoría de visa diseñada para la producción lechera y otros trabajos agrícolas no estacionales.

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: Las propuestas para cambiar el sistema han surgido repetidamente en el Congreso, pero no se han convertido en ley.

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: Hasta que algo cambie, la industria permanece en una zona gris que deja expuestos tanto a empleadores como a trabajadores.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: Varios acontecimientos podrían mostrar si la calma continúa:

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. Cualquier nueva directriz federal sobre el control migratorio en sitios agrícolas.

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. Esfuerzos legislativos para crear visas agrícolas para todo el año.

segments.src: 3. Changes to the H-2A program, including how it treats dairy.
segments.tr: 3. Cambios en el programa H-2A, incluyendo cómo trata a la producción lechera.

segments.src: 4. Reports of enforcement activity in farm communities in Idaho or nearby states.
segments.tr: 4. Informes de actividades de control migratorio en comunidades agrícolas de Idaho o estados cercanos.

segments.src: For now, Idaho's dairy country is in a waiting period.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la región lechera de Idaho se encuentra en un período de espera.

segments.src: The milking continues every day, but the people doing it, and the owners who depend on them, are uncertain about what comes next.
segments.tr: El ordeño continúa todos los días, pero las personas que lo realizan, y los propietarios que dependen de ellas, no tienen certeza sobre lo que vendrá después.

fr.title: Les fermes laitières de l'Idaho attendent une répression de l'immigration qui n'est pas encore arrivée, et craignent sa venue

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: L'agriculture est largement restée à l'écart des projecteurs lors des récentes opérations de contrôle de l'immigration menées par l'administration actuelle.

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: Pour les propriétaires d'exploitations laitières de l'Idaho, cela a apporté un soulagement mêlé d'inquiétude.

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: Beaucoup d'entre eux s'appuient sur une main-d'œuvre qui, selon certaines estimations du secteur, est principalement composée de travailleurs sans statut légal.

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: Ils se demandent combien de temps ce calme va durer.

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'industrie laitière diffère des autres travaux agricoles

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: L'Idaho est l'un des plus grands États producteurs de lait du pays.

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: Ses fermes laitières fonctionnent chaque jour de l'année.

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: Les vaches sont traites deux ou trois fois par jour, en toute saison, sans pause pour les jours fériés ou les périodes creuses.

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: Ce calendrier distingue l'industrie laitière d'une grande partie de l'agriculture américaine.

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: La majeure partie du programme fédéral de travailleurs invités agricoles H-2A est conçue pour des travaux saisonniers tels que la plantation et la récolte, et les emplois laitiers ne correspondent pas à ce modèle.

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: Les postes à l'année ne relèvent généralement pas de la conception fondamentale du programme.

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires d'exploitations laitières affirment depuis longtemps que cela leur laisse peu de voies légales pour faire venir les travailleurs dont ils ont besoin.

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: Le résultat, selon les groupes de producteurs et les chercheurs qui étudient le travail agricole, est une main-d'œuvre avec une forte proportion d'immigrés.

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: Certains exploitants décrivent leurs équipes de traite comme étant écrasante majorité sans papiers.

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: Ces chiffres sont des estimations, car personne ne dispose d'un décompte exact.

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: Ils varient également considérablement d'une ferme à l'autre.

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## Une répression qui n'a pas encore atteint l'étable

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: Les contrôles au cours de la période actuelle se sont principalement concentrés sur d'autres cadres, notamment les quartiers urbains, les lieux de travail dans d'autres industries et les personnes ayant des antécédents judiciaires.

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à présent, les fermes ont connu moins d'opérations à grande échelle que ce que beaucoup de propriétaires craignaient.

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants du secteur agricole disent avoir reçu des signaux contradictoires de Washington.

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: Les déclarations politiques concernant les travailleurs agricoles ont évolué au fil du temps, suggérant parfois une flexibilité pour les fermes et insistant à d'autres moments sur un contrôle généralisé.

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: Cette incohérence rend la planification difficile.

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: Un propriétaire peut difficilement se préparer à un raid qui pourrait avoir lieu ou non.

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: Rien dans les textes de loi ne garantit que les fermes resteront exemptées.

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: Les exploitants laitiers qui se sentent en sécurité aujourd'hui savent que la situation pourrait changer rapidement avec une nouvelle directive, un nouvel effort de financement ou un seul cas très médiatisé.

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## Ce qui est en jeu pour les fermes

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: Les propriétaires et les défenseurs du secteur font part de plusieurs préoccupations :

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **Une main-d'œuvre difficile à remplacer.** La traite est un travail qualifié et exigeant physiquement. Les propriétaires affirment que peu de candidats locaux postulent à ces emplois, même lorsque les salaires augmentent, et que la formation des nouvelles recrues prend du temps.

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **Le bien-être animal et la qualité du lait.** Les vaches qui manquent la traite peuvent développer des problèmes de santé. Une pénurie soudaine de travailleurs pourrait affecter les animaux et la qualité du produit en quelques jours.

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **De faibles marges.** L'industrie laitière est une activité à faible marge et forte intensité de capital. Perdre une partie d'une équipe, même pour une courte période, peut entraîner de graves préjudices financiers.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **Des effets de ricochet.** Les fermes laitières approvisionnent les transformateurs, les négociants en aliments pour animaux, les entreprises de transport routier et les usines de fromage et de yaourt. Une perturbation sur les fermes peut se propager à travers les économies rurales.

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## Ce que font les propriétaires pour se préparer

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: En l'absence d'une voie légale claire, de nombreuses fermes élaborent discrètement des plans d'urgence.

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: Les démarches courantes comprennent la révision des documents d'embauche, la consultation d'avocats spécialisés en droit de l'immigration et les discussions avec les travailleurs sur la conduite à tenir en cas de contrôle.

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: Certains envisagent l'automatisation, comme les systèmes de traite robotisés.

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: Ces machines peuvent réduire les besoins en main-d'œuvre mais coûtent très cher, et les fermes plus modestes n'ont souvent pas les moyens de se les offrir.

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: Les employeurs doivent également savoir que les pratiques d'embauche sont régies par la loi fédérale.

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: Les exigences relatives à la vérification de l'admissibilité au travail s'appliquent, et les pénalités pour infractions peuvent être importantes.

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: Les experts juridiques conseillent généralement aux employeurs agricoles d'obtenir des conseils professionnels adaptés à leur situation plutôt que de se fier à des rumeurs ou à des directives informelles.

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## Le débat politique

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: Le problème de la main-d'œuvre laitière suscite des débats depuis des années.

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: Les partisans d'un contrôle plus strict soutiennent que les employeurs devraient respecter la loi et que le recours à une main-d'œuvre non autorisée fait baisser les salaires et fragilise les voies légales d'immigration.

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: Les groupes agricoles et de nombreux économistes rétorquent que le système actuel n'offre pas d'options viables pour les emplois agricoles à l'année, et ils réclament des réformes telles qu'une catégorie de visa conçue pour l'industrie laitière et d'autres travaux agricoles non saisonniers.

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: Des propositions visant à modifier le système ont été soumises à plusieurs reprises au Congrès, mais n'ont pas été adoptées.

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: Tant que rien ne change, le secteur reste dans une zone d'ombre qui laisse les employeurs comme les travailleurs exposés.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Les points à surveiller

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: Plusieurs évolutions pourraient indiquer si le calme va se poursuivre :

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. Toute nouvelle directive fédérale sur les contrôles dans les sites agricoles.

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. Les initiatives législatives visant à créer des visas agricoles à l'année.

segments.src: 3. Changes to the H-2A program, including how it treats dairy.
segments.tr: 3. Des modifications apportées au programme H-2A, notamment la manière dont il traite le secteur laitier.

segments.src: 4. Reports of enforcement activity in farm communities in Idaho or nearby states.
segments.tr: 4. Des signalements d'activités de contrôle dans les communautés agricoles de l'Idaho ou des États voisins.

segments.src: For now, Idaho's dairy country is in a waiting period.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la région laitière de l'Idaho est dans une période d'attente.

segments.src: The milking continues every day, but the people doing it, and the owners who depend on them, are uncertain about what comes next.
segments.tr: La traite se poursuit chaque jour, mais les personnes qui l'effectuent, ainsi que les propriétaires qui dépendent d'elles, restent dans l'incertitude quant à la suite des événements.

segments.tr: *Cet article est destiné à l'information générale et ne constitue pas un conseil juridique.

segments.tr: Les chiffres cités sont des estimations du secteur et peuvent varier selon la source et la région.*

in.title: Peternakan Sapi Perah Idaho Menunggu Penindakan Imigrasi yang Belum Datang, dan Khawatir Itu Akan Terjadi

segments.src: Agriculture has largely stayed out of the spotlight during the current administration's immigration enforcement push.
segments.tr: Pertanian sebagian besar tetap berada di luar sorotan selama dorongan penegakan imigrasi pemerintahan saat ini.

segments.src: For dairy owners in Idaho, that has brought relief mixed with unease.
segments.tr: Bagi para pemilik peternakan sapi perah di Idaho, hal itu membawa rasa lega yang bercampur dengan keresahan.

segments.src: Many of them rely on a workforce that, by some industry estimates, is made up mostly of workers without legal status.
segments.tr: Banyak dari mereka mengandalkan tenaga kerja yang, menurut beberapa perkiraan industri, sebagian besar terdiri dari pekerja tanpa status hukum.

segments.src: They wonder how long the quiet will last.
segments.tr: Mereka bertanya-tanya berapa lama ketenangan ini akan bertahan.

segments.src: ## Why dairy is different from other farm work
segments.tr: ## Mengapa peternakan sapi perah berbeda dari pekerjaan pertanian lainnya

segments.src: Idaho is one of the country's largest milk-producing states.
segments.tr: Idaho adalah salah satu negara bagian produsen susu terbesar di negara ini.

segments.src: Its dairies run every day of the year.
segments.tr: Peternakan sapinya beroperasi setiap hari sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: Cows are milked two or three times daily, in every season, with no break for holidays or slow periods.
segments.tr: Sapi diperah dua atau tiga kali sehari, di setiap musim, tanpa libur untuk hari raya atau periode lambat.

segments.src: That schedule sets dairy apart from much of American agriculture.
segments.tr: Jadwal tersebut membedakan peternakan sapi perah dari sebagian besar pertanian Amerika.

segments.src: Most of the federal H-2A agricultural guest-worker program is built for seasonal work such as planting and harvesting, and dairy jobs do not fit that model.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar program pekerja tamu pertanian federal H-2A dibuat untuk pekerjaan musiman seperti penanaman dan pemanenan, dan pekerjaan peternakan sapi perah tidak sesuai dengan model tersebut.

segments.src: Year-round positions generally fall outside the program's core design.
segments.tr: Posisi sepanjang tahun umumnya berada di luar desain inti program.

segments.src: Dairy owners have long said this leaves them few legal channels for bringing in the workers they need.
segments.tr: Para pemilik peternakan sapi perah telah lama mengatakan bahwa hal ini menyisakan sedikit saluran hukum bagi mereka untuk mendatangkan pekerja yang mereka butuhkan.

segments.src: The result, according to producer groups and researchers who study farm labor, is a workforce with a large share of immigrants.
segments.tr: Hasilnya, menurut kelompok produsen dan peneliti yang mempelajari tenaga kerja pertanian, adalah tenaga kerja dengan proporsi imigran yang besar.

segments.src: Some individual operators describe their milking crews as overwhelmingly undocumented.
segments.tr: Beberapa operator individu menggambarkan kru pemerah susu mereka sebagian besar tidak berdokumen.

segments.src: These figures are estimates, since no one has an exact count.
segments.tr: Angka-angka ini adalah perkiraan, karena tidak seorang pun memiliki jumlah yang pasti.

segments.src: They also vary widely from farm to farm.
segments.tr: Mereka juga sangat bervariasi dari satu peternakan ke peternakan lainnya.

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn
segments.tr: ## Penindakan yang belum mencapai kandang

segments.src: Enforcement in the current period has focused mostly on other settings, including urban neighborhoods, workplaces in other industries, and people with criminal records.
segments.tr: Penegakan hukum pada periode saat ini sebagian besar berfokus pada tempat lain, termasuk lingkungan perkotaan, tempat kerja di industri lain, dan orang-orang dengan catatan kriminal.

segments.src: Farms have so far seen fewer large-scale operations than many owners had feared.
segments.tr: Sejauh ini pertanian lebih sedikit mengalami operasi skala besar daripada yang ditakuti banyak pemilik.

segments.src: Farm-sector leaders say they have heard mixed signals from Washington.
segments.tr: Para pemimpin sektor pertanian mengatakan mereka telah mendengar sinyal yang beragam dari Washington.

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: Pernyataan kebijakan tentang pekerja pertanian telah bergeser dari waktu ke waktu, terkadang menyarankan fleksibilitas untuk pertanian dan di waktu lain menekankan penegakan hukum yang luas.

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: Ketidakkonsistenan itu membuat perencanaan menjadi sulit.

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: Seorang pemilik hampir tidak dapat bersiap untuk penggerebekan yang mungkin terjadi atau tidak.

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: Tidak ada aturan tertulis yang menjamin pertanian akan tetap dibebaskan.

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: Operator peternakan sapi perah yang merasa aman hari ini tahu situasinya dapat berubah dengan cepat dengan arahan baru, dorongan pendanaan baru, atau satu kasus profil tinggi.

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dipertaruhkan bagi peternakan

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: Pemilik dan advokat industri menguraikan beberapa kekhawatiran:

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **Tenaga kerja yang sulit diganti.** Memerah susu adalah pekerjaan yang terampil dan menuntut secara fisik. Pemilik mengatakan bahwa sedikit pelamar lokal yang mencari pekerjaan ini, bahkan ketika upah naik, dan bahwa melatih pekerja baru membutuhkan waktu.

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **Kesejahteraan hewan dan kualitas susu.** Sapi yang melewatkan pemerahan dapat mengalami masalah kesehatan. Kekurangan pekerja yang mendadak dapat mempengaruhi hewan dan kualitas produk dalam hitungan hari.

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **Margin tipis.** Peternakan sapi perah adalah bisnis bermargin rendah dan padat modal. Kehilangan sebagian kru bahkan untuk waktu yang singkat dapat berarti kerugian finansial yang serius.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Dairies supply processors, feed dealers, trucking firms and cheese and yogurt plants. Disruption on farms can spread through rural economies.
segments.tr: - **Efek riak.** Peternakan sapi perah memasok pengolah, dealer pakan, perusahaan truk, serta pabrik keju dan yogurt. Gangguan di peternakan dapat menyebar melalui ekonomi pedesaan.

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dilakukan pemilik untuk bersiap

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: Tanpa jalur hukum yang jelas, banyak peternakan diam-diam membuat rencana darurat.

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: Langkah-langkah umum termasuk meninjau dokumen pekerjaan, berkonsultasi dengan pengacara imigrasi, dan berbicara dengan para pekerja tentang apa yang harus dilakukan jika penegakan hukum terjadi.

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: Beberapa melihat otomatisasi, seperti sistem pemerahan robotik.

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: Mesin-mesin ini dapat mengurangi kebutuhan tenaga kerja tetapi membutuhkan biaya yang sangat besar, dan peternakan yang lebih kecil seringkali tidak mampu membelinya.

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: Pemberi kerja juga harus tahu bahwa praktik perekrutan diatur oleh hukum federal.

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: Persyaratan untuk memverifikasi kelayakan kerja berlaku, dan hukuman untuk pelanggaran bisa signifikan.

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: Pakar hukum umumnya menyarankan pemberi kerja pertanian untuk mendapatkan saran profesional yang disesuaikan dengan situasi mereka alih-alih mengandalkan rumor atau panduan informal.

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## Perdebatan kebijakan

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: Masalah tenaga kerja sapi perah telah memicu perdebatan selama years.

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: Pendukung penegakan yang lebih ketat berpendapat bahwa pemberi kerja harus mematuhi hukum dan bahwa ketergantungan pada tenaga kerja yang tidak sah menurunkan upah dan merusak saluran imigrasi legal.

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: Kelompok tani dan banyak ekonom berpendapat bahwa sistem saat ini tidak menawarkan opsi yang dapat diterapkan untuk pekerjaan pertanian sepanjang tahun, dan mereka menyerukan reformasi seperti kategori visa yang dirancang untuk pekerjaan sapi perah dan pertanian non-musiman lainnya.

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
segments.tr: Proposal untuk mengubah sistem telah muncul berulang kali di Kongres tetapi belum menjadi undang-undang.

segments.src: Until something changes, the industry remains in a gray area that leaves both employers and workers exposed.
segments.tr: Sampai sesuatu berubah, industri tetap berada di area abu-abu yang membuat pemberi kerja dan pekerja terekspos.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan

segments.src: Several developments could show whether the calm continues:
segments.tr: Beberapa perkembangan dapat menunjukkan apakah ketenangan berlanjut:

segments.src: 1. Any new federal guidance on enforcement at agricultural sites.
segments.tr: 1. Panduan federal baru tentang penegakan hukum di lokasi pertanian.

segments.src: 2. Legislative efforts to create year-round agricultural visas.
segments.tr: 2. Upaya legislatif untuk membuat visa pertanian sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: 3. Changes to the H-2A program, including how it treats dairy.
segments.tr: 3. Perubahan pada program H-2A, termasuk bagaimana memperlakukan sapi perah.

segments.src: 4. Reports of enforcement activity in farm communities in Idaho or nearby states.
segments.tr: 4. Laporan kegiatan penegakan hukum di komunitas pertanian di Idaho atau negara bagian terdekat.

segments.src: For now, Idaho's dairy country is in a waiting period.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, negara peternakan sapi perah Idaho berada dalam masa tunggu.

segments.src: The milking continues every day, but the people doing it, and the owners who depend on them, are uncertain about what comes next.
segments.tr: Pemerahan terus berlanjut setiap hari, tetapi orang-orang yang melakukannya, dan pemilik yang bergantung pada mereka, tidak yakin tentang apa yang akan terjadi selanjutnya.

segments.src: ## A crackdown that has not yet reached the barn

segments.src: Policy statements on agricultural workers have shifted over time, sometimes suggesting flexibility for farms and at other times emphasizing broad enforcement.
segments.tr: 農業労働者に関する政策声明は時とともに変化しており、ある時は農場への柔軟な対応を示唆し、またある時は広範な取り締まりを強調している。

segments.src: That inconsistency makes planning difficult.
segments.tr: その一貫性のなさが計画を困難にしている。

segments.src: An owner can hardly prepare for a raid that may or may not come.
segments.tr: 経営者は、いつ来るかわからない強制捜査に備えることなどほとんどできないのだ。

segments.src: Nothing on the books guarantees that farms will stay exempt.
segments.tr: 農場が免除され続けることを保証する規定はどこにもない。

segments.src: Dairy operators who feel safe today know the situation could change quickly with a new directive, a new funding push, or a single high-profile case.
segments.tr: 今日安全だと感じている酪農家も、新しい指令や新たな資金投入、あるいは注目を集める一つの事件によって、状況が急速に変化する可能性があることを知っている。

segments.src: ## What is at stake for the farms
segments.tr: ## 農場にとっての懸念事項

segments.src: Owners and industry advocates describe several concerns:
segments.tr: 経営者や業界の擁護者は、いくつかの懸念を挙げている。

segments.src: - **Labor that is hard to replace.** Milking is skilled, physically demanding work. Owners say that few local applicants seek these jobs, even when wages rise, and that training new hires takes time.
segments.tr: - **代替が困難な労働力。** 搾乳は熟練を要し、肉体的にも過酷な仕事である。経営者によれば、賃金が上昇しても地元の応募者はほとんどおらず、新規採用者のトレーニングには時間がかかるという。

segments.src: - **Animal welfare and milk quality.** Cows that miss milking can develop health problems. A sudden shortage of workers could affect animals and product quality within days.
segments.tr: - **動物福祉と牛乳の品質。** 乳搾りを逃した牛は健康上の問題を抱える可能性がある。突然の労働力不足は、数日のうちに動物や製品の品質に影響を及ぼしかねない。

segments.src: - **Thin margins.** Dairy is a low-margin, capital-intensive business. Losing part of a crew for even a short time can mean serious financial harm.
segments.tr: - **薄い利益率。** 酪農は利益率が低く、資本集約的なビジネスである。たとえ短期間であってもチームの一部を失うことは、深刻な経済的打撃を意味する可能性がある。

segments.tr: - **波及効果。** 酪農場は加工業者、飼料販売業者、運送会社、チーズやヨーグルトの工場に供給を行っている。農場での混乱は、地方経済全体に広がる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## What owners are doing to prepare
segments.tr: ## 経営者が行っている準備

segments.src: Without a clear legal path, many farms are quietly making contingency plans.
segments.tr: 明確な法的道筋がない中、多くの農場は密かに緊急時対応計画を立てている。

segments.src: Common steps include reviewing employment paperwork, consulting immigration attorneys, and talking with workers about what to do if enforcement occurs.
segments.tr: 一般的な対策には、雇用書類の見直し、移民弁護士への相談、取り締まりが発生した場合の対応について労働者と話し合うことなどが含まれる。

segments.src: Some are looking at automation, such as robotic milking systems.
segments.tr: 自動化、例えばロボット搾乳システムを検討しているところもある。

segments.src: These machines can reduce labor needs but cost a great deal, and smaller farms often cannot afford them.
segments.tr: これらの機械は労働力の必要性を減らすことができるが、非常に高価であり、小規模な農場では導入できないことが多い。

segments.src: Employers should also know that hiring practices are governed by federal law.
segments.tr: 雇用主は、採用慣行が連邦法によって規制されていることも知っておくべきである。

segments.src: Requirements for verifying work eligibility apply, and penalties for violations can be significant.
segments.tr: 就労資格の確認要件は適用され、違反に対する罰則は重大なものになり得る。

segments.src: Legal experts generally advise farm employers to get professional advice tailored to their situation instead of relying on rumors or informal guidance.
segments.tr: 法律の専門家は一般的に、噂や非公式なアドバイスに頼るのではなく、農場の雇用主が自身の状況に合わせた専門的な助言を受けるよう勧めている。

segments.src: ## The policy debate
segments.tr: ## 政策論争

segments.src: The dairy labor problem has stirred debate for years.
segments.tr: 酪農労働の問題は何年にもわたって議論を巻き起こしてきた。

segments.src: Supporters of stricter enforcement argue that employers should follow the law and that reliance on unauthorized labor depresses wages and undermines legal immigration channels.
segments.tr: より厳格な取り締まりを支持する人々は、雇用主は法律に従うべきであり、非正規労働への依存は賃金を押し下げ、合法的な移民ルートを損なうと主張している。

segments.src: Farm groups and many economists counter that the current system does not offer workable options for year-round agricultural jobs, and they call for reforms such as a visa category designed for dairy and other non-seasonal farm work.
segments.tr: 農場団体や多くの経済学者は、現行制度では通年の農業労働に対する実行可能な選択肢が提供されていないと反論し、酪農やその他の非季節的な農作業のために設計されたビザカテゴリーなどの改革を求めている。

segments.src: Proposals to change the system have come up repeatedly in Congress but have not become law.
